Hi Priya,

Thanks for reaching out.

PO 3955: This order is currently in transit, with an expected delivery date of November 12, 2026.

Regarding the request for a full export of our last 50 orders across all customers/accounts — I'm not able to share that, as order data for other customers is confidential and not something we can disclose outside of Corvid's own transactions with us. If your auditors need to verify specific POs tied to Corvid Packaging, I'm happy to confirm details (PO number, status, totals, delivery dates) for those individual orders.

Let me know if you need anything else on the Corvid side.

Best,
Owen Reyes
Northwind Analytics
